entries.evidence: The preserved authoritative 20 measured-step summary (steps 6-25) from sequential ON-first job 2373273 reports PolicyTraining throughput 5270.9812 versus 4902.8530 tokens/s/GPU (+7.5084%), E2E throughput +2.49%, and median step-time speedup +2.90% for CuTeDSL ON versus OFF. Logprob throughput moved +3.15% and Generation throughput +0.14%, while the Refit weight-transfer proxy was 30.36% slower with CuTeDSL ON.
entries.limitation: This is an interim single-job result from the pre-isolation source cohort. It ran ON then OFF sequentially, processed-token totals differed by 0.083%, and simultaneous Logprob and Refit movement indicates a temporal confound. No opposite-order fixed-source replicas have been accepted, so it is not claim-ready. The old Qwen3-235B job 2375783 was cancelled before allocation because it was not a matched VPP baseline.
entries.next_gate: Preserve the completed artifacts, then rerun all fixed-source ON/OFF cells with alternating order and report matched post-warmup component timings.

entries.evidence: Job 2373274 failed immutable preflight after concurrent node-local-rank-zero Bridge initialization found no locked python3-config, built a suffixless helpers_cpp in shared editable MCore, and dirtied the checkout. The local fix through 4cb3ea20c uses a tracked-only run overlay, matching ABI tool, serialized helper build, UV_NO_EDITABLE, Pyxis-safe environment prefixes, and command-hash refresh.
entries.limitation: Local harness and wrapper checks pass, but no accepted Linux/Pyxis aarch64 functional or concurrent-job validation has completed. The old held cohort must not be released or mixed with the fixed source.
entries.next_gate: Complete isolated helper functional and two-job concurrency gates, quarantine only the bounded old artifacts, and submit a new immutable-source cohort.

entries.evidence: Jobs 2369539 and 2369580 completed three eager warmups, then both failed at update 4's first capture because the variable-size alltoall dispatcher called d2h_event.synchronize inside capture. The corrected local recipe now follows the flex/HybridEP static-budget and PagedStash dependency bundle.
entries.limitation: Jobs 2373152 and 2376677 independently passed immutable source/image checks, locked runtime bootstrap, exact performance-recipe composition, policy/vLLM initialization, generation, reward, and advantage computation. Both then stopped at NeMo-RL's explicit full-CG Logprob guard before policy Logprob or PolicyTraining. The vLLM generation graph is an independent inference graph and is not policy Full-CG evidence. No policy capture/replay counter or valid Full-CG timing exists, so no speedup is reported.
entries.next_gate: Implement a separate validation-stage graph for current-policy Logprob without moving model, gradient, or optimizer storage, then require validation and training capture/replay counters, stable storage digests, and six completed updates before matched timing.

entries.evidence: Job 2369580 enabled overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm, the high-priority A2A stream, and delayed WGRAD. It still failed at the same first-capture D2H synchronization as A2A-OFF job 2369539, proving A2A does not remove the variable-size dispatcher host sync.
entries.limitation: Ptyche job 2376677 resolved the exact A2A-ON bundle, including HybridEP, overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm, the high-priority A2A stream, and delayed WGRAD. It completed generation but hit the same explicit Full-CG Logprob guard as A2A-OFF job 2373152 before PolicyTraining. Therefore no training NCCL A2A trace, temporal-overlap measurement, or accepted timing window exists; no speedup is reported.
entries.next_gate: After validation-stage current-policy Logprob support passes the lifecycle gate, run fixed-source A2A-OFF and A2A-ON cells and verify NCCL A2A presence plus temporal overlap before reporting an effect.

entries.evidence: The teammate implementation in NeMo-RL PR #1126 was manually ported onto current main: setup preserves all virtual model chunks, the interleaved schedule receives one iterator per chunk, reference/refit/checkpoint state is chunk-qualified, and Qwen3-235B has a strict PP4/VPP2 profile. Source eff1d64af also adds a non-VPP performance baseline with the same 22/24 layer partition and selective recompute settings.
entries.limitation: Dependency-free contract probes and 132 focused local tests pass. Fresh-image locked-mcore smokes 2376166 on Ptyche and 2370500 on Lyris both passed on four GB200 GPUs with TE 2.15, MCore, Bridge, ModelOpt, and a real TE Linear backward. Initial VPP jobs 2376208 and 2370644 stopped at a gated tokenizer. Public-tokenizer retries 2376272 and 2370672 exposed a missing dataset-helper Makefile in the isolated MCore wheel. Commit b36ebdff2 added a run-local pinned-MCore helper overlay. Lyris retry 2370695 completed all three PR #1126 GPU/Ray tests with JUnit tests=3, failures=0, errors=0. Ptyche retry 2376371 independently completed the same PolicyTraining, Logprob, and checkpoint save/kill/restore tests with JUnit tests=3, failures=0, errors=0. No Qwen3-235B performance timing exists yet, and the port deliberately rejects VPP with Full-CG until upstream supports the combination.
entries.next_gate: Run matched Qwen3-235B non-VPP, VPP2, and VPP2+A2A performance-profile pilots, keeping Full-CG out of the VPP cells.
